prompt_quirks.context: set num_ctx explicitly on Ollama; default is small

notes: Self-hosted (Ollama/vLLM): no per-token price, USD 0. The ledger prices bare open-weight ids such as 'qwen2.5:7b' at conservative hosted rates unless the model id is prefixed 'ollama:' or 'local:'.
